title: Majority of New Projects in ISO-NE Transitional Cluster have Withdrawn

meta.summary:
Facing interconnection cost estimates averaging over $100 million, most new projects and the majority of new capacity participating in ISO-NE’s Transitional Cluster Study have withdrawn from the RTO’s interconnection queue. 
 The post  Majority of New Projects in ISO-NE Transitional Cluster have Withdrawn  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
